Dense_D: Frozen joint D: answer->image blocked all28; R->image blocked L20-27; L2-5 answer o_proj output zero; dense KV retained
Physical_D: Image Hidden physically removed before L20; L2-5 P-1 and Decode excluded from QKV/QK/AV/o_proj; original positions retained; persistent original image KV removed all layers; no persistent KV at L2-5
Native: Official unmodified full model, including answer direct image access

numerical_gate.native_noop: all effective logits torch.equal; full token IDs exact
numerical_gate.historical_D: complete tokens and SHA256 of every float32 effective logit exact on three historical samples
numerical_gate.hidden_relative_RMS: RMS(physical-dense)/max(RMS(dense),1e-6), aligned by original logical positions; all shared rows
numerical_gate.rationale: Predeclared BF16 engineering tolerances: absolute logits 0.125 and mean 0.01; layer hidden RMS difference <=1/64. These are numerical agreement gates, not quality noninferiority thresholds.
numerical_gate.failure_policy: Stop formal quality and efficiency on failure. Diagnose earliest mismatch; preserve each attempt. No post-hoc tolerance changes.

warmup: 2 requests per method before timing; every input gets 5 independently restarted requests/method
timer: CUDA-synchronized perf_counter from GPU-ready pixels/IDs through vision/projector/injection/prefill/31decode and transient cleanup. Persistent cache kept live for measurement. Disk/tokenization/preprocessing/H2D/model load/output serialization excluded.
KV: actual tensor numel*element_size; capacity unique live underlying storage.nbytes, never allocator peak or theoretical token count
efficiency_order: input-major, repeat-major; rotate three-method order by input+repeat
bootstrap: paired image-SHA cluster resampling, question-weighted; ordinary exploratory 95% CI
smoke_execution: Three historical samples indices 525/1928/1127 plus new frozen shortest/central/longest; six samples total; normal EOS first; fixed32 cache/call extension only if numeric gates pass

user_override.exact_user_instruction: 0.0004不大吧，在小测试集上得分差不多就行
user_override.scope: Run frozen120 same-question paired quality pilot, then originally authorized30-input efficiency. Preserve strict numerical FAILED and report real quality damage; do not assert strict equivalence.

timer_cleanup_amendment: Start before method hook/forward installation; finish after restoration and final CUDA sync. No audit hooks during formal timing.
